text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though I got caught up in Gold Ship's quest to find Eden…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I somehow still managed to get her ready for her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I'm worried about anything right now, it's about how Gold Ship is feeling. She, however…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, good job! Yes, come on! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now it's just a matter of when to shake! D'aww, I just can't stop watching!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'm watching that chihuahua over there through this stick of chikuwa.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There are some things that are only comprehensible when seen through the small hole of a chikuwa.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That chihuahua must be thinking hard about the best time to hold out its paw for a shake, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's the same focus we Umamusume have when we're thinking about the best time to make our move during a race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her comparison is hard to follow, but I guess Gold Ship must be thinking about the next race… in her own unique way.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What?! Why is it lying down now of all times?! That was obviously the moment to do a paw shake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In any case, I just have to pray she gives it her all out on the racecourse!
